newsitem.title: USA: Hewlett-Packard Q4 orders rose 15 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hewlett-Packard Q4 orders rose 15 percent.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co said orders rose 15 percent for the 1996 fiscal year's fourth quarter, which ended October 31.

Orders for the quarter were $10 billion, with U.S. orders up 10 percent to $4.7 billion and overseas orders up 20 percent to $5.3 billion. In the third quarter of 1996, H-P orders rose 8.0 percent, with U.S. orders gaining four percent and overseas orders rising 11 percent.
In last year's fourth quarter, H-P reported a 27 percent increase in orders, with U.S. orders gaining 26 percent and overseas orders rising 29 percent.
